teacherHint: Click Enter to open the BODA app. If this is your first visit, you'll be guided through installation.

embed.desktopHint: Use the desktop app if installed, or open the room in a new browser tab.
embed.openInBrowser: Open in a new browser tab
embed.openInBrowserUnavailable: Available after the operator finishes the BODA setup.
embed.iframeFallbackToast: Embed not allowed — falling back to the desktop app / new tab.
embed.macMobileHint: On Mac and mobile we can't automatically detect whether the app is installed. If it doesn't open, use ‘Open in browser’ or follow the install guide.

closeReason.OPEN_FAILED: Classroom failed to open and was closed.
closeReason.UNUSED: Unused classroom was cleaned up automatically.
closeReason.NO_USERS: No attendees — the room was closed automatically.
closeReason.AUTO: Class time ended — the room was auto-closed.

demo.bannerHint: Runs through a simulator instead of the real BODA client.
demo.studentWaiting: The teacher will open the classroom shortly.
demo.studentLive: 🎥 Class in progress — in production, the BODA desktop app would launch automatically.

teacherJoined: Your teacher has entered the classroom.
waitingHint: The Enter button becomes active once your teacher opens the classroom (auto-refresh every 10 seconds).

roomEnded.default: This classroom is not available for entry.

unknown.title: Could not enter the classroom
unknown.body: Please retry shortly or contact your administrator.

BODA_LAUNCH_OUT_OF_WINDOW.title: Not within the entry window
BODA_LAUNCH_OUT_OF_WINDOW.body: You can enter from 10 minutes before the start to 15 minutes after the end.

BODA_NOT_BODASCHOOL.title: Not a BODA School classroom
BODA_NOT_BODASCHOOL.body: This event uses a different video system. Check the meeting URL in the schedule.

BODA_ROOM_NOT_PROVISIONED.title: Classroom not yet provisioned
BODA_ROOM_NOT_PROVISIONED.body: Ask an admin to re-save the event and the classroom will be re-created automatically.

NOT_AN_ATTENDEE.title: You are not authorized for this classroom
NOT_AN_ATTENDEE.body: Only invited students and the assigned teacher can join.

EVENT_NOT_FOUND.title: Event not found
EVENT_NOT_FOUND.body: The event was deleted or the link is invalid.

BODA-NOT_INSTALLED.title: BODA School app is not installed
BODA-NOT_INSTALLED.body: Visit the installation guide and try again.

BODA-NOT_CONNECTED_AGENT.title: Not connected to the BODA app
BODA-NOT_CONNECTED_AGENT.body: Confirm the app is running and retry.

BODA-ALREADY_EXECUTE_PROGRAM.title: The BODA app is already running
BODA-ALREADY_EXECUTE_PROGRAM.body: Check the existing classroom window, or quit the app and enter again.

BODA-UPDATE_PROGRAM.title: The BODA app is updating
BODA-UPDATE_PROGRAM.body: Please wait for the update to finish and try again.

BODA-NOT_SUPPORTED_DEVICE.title: Unsupported device
BODA-NOT_SUPPORTED_DEVICE.body: Use ‘Open in browser’ or try again on a supported device.
